opencode-v2.description: Use as the primary source for OpenCode V2 architecture, API, client, desktop, and UI behavior. Prefer V2 documentation and implementation in this branch over legacy OpenCode sources.

t3chat-inspiration.description: Use as a first-party T3 reference for chat interface, interaction, timeline, and desktop product inspiration. T3 Chat itself does not have a public first-party source repository.

orca-inspiration.description: Use as a reference for parallel-agent fleet UX, worktree workflows, terminal and review surfaces, remote access, mobile companion behavior, and desktop productivity patterns. Preserve Palot's OpenCode-native ownership boundaries instead of copying Orca's orchestration state model.
